meta.title: Aries 2027 — Vishnu ji drafts, Sakshi notes
meta.version: v7 voice cut (one take per speaker, natural pace)
meta.cta: send to an Aries friend + link to the month-wise Aries 2027 guide (link-based only; owner rule)
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count
meta.source: Aries 2027 summary given by the owner, 23 Nov 2026 (Vedic: Saturn 12th then 1st, Jupiter 5th, Rahu 10th / Ketu 4th)

beats.line: Prabhu, Aries ka 2027 likhne se pehle zara meri baat sun lijiye. Main Aries walon ki wakeel hun.
beats.picture: Night cloud study. Vishnu ji on his cloud; the 'ARIES 2027' scroll floats and a magic quill writes by itself. Sakshi zooms in on a small cloud, black wakeel coat over her outfit, diary floating open; she raises a polite hand and the quill pauses mid-word.
beats.camera: Opens mid-motion on the quill; whip to Sakshi.
beats.card: Hook card from frame 0: 'ARIES 2027: BHAGWAN SE MOL-BHAAV?'

beats.line: Mesh walon ko wakeel ki nahi, brake ki zaroorat hai.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji amused, eyebrow up. Cut-in: a cartoon ram charges at full speed with no brakes and skids past a STOP sign.
beats.camera: Push in, cut-in on the ram.

beats.line: Waise is saal Shani dev ki Sade Sati chal rahi hai.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji calm, writing; the scroll writes 'SADE SATI' in deep blue; a small respectful Shani symbol glows (Shani dev not shown).
beats.camera: Slow push in, light dims a touch.

beats.line: Saade saat saal?! Prabhu, Aries walon se toh 7 minute wait nahi hota!
beats.picture: Sakshi's eyes go wide, then she laughs at Aries impatience: a big '7 MIN?' timer pops up and runs out.
beats.sound: Vine boom, then a cash-register ding.

beats.line: Isiliye toh Shani dev sabar sikhayenge. Aur Guru saath hain, ghabrao mat.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji warm smile, gentle head shake; a soft golden Jupiter glow rises and the gloom clears. Sakshi exhales.
beats.camera: Gentle pull back, warm light returns.
beats.card: Card: 'SHANI = MEHNAT KA PHAL · GURU = KRIPA' + 'Vedic maanyata'

beats.line: March-April aur August se October tak sehat ka thoda dhyaan rakhna. July mein toh ekdum fit rahoge.
beats.picture: Diary page: HEALTH with the two careful windows; a flexing-arm doodle labelled 'JULY FIT' on the last words.
beats.card: Card: 'HEALTH ⚠ 9 Mar–26 Apr · 24 Aug–8 Oct' + small 'Doctor ki salah zaroor lein'

beats.line: Toh July mein gym join kar lete hain!
beats.picture: Sakshi excited, a tiny dumbbell doodle pops in her diary.

beats.line: Join toh har saal karte hain, is baar jaana bhi padega.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji deadpan, slow blink; the dumbbell doodle sags. Sakshi sheepish grin.
beats.camera: Two-shot, tiny punch-in on the deadpan.

beats.line: Office mein kaam ka pressure rahega, aur koi na koi boss ke kaan bharega.

caption_chunks.text: aur koi na koi boss ke

beats.picture: Cut-in: a tiny cartoon office; a faceless colleague whispers into a boss's huge ear. Vishnu ji raises one brow.

beats.line: Naam bataiye, abhi notice bhejti hun!
beats.picture: Sakshi rolls up her wakeel sleeves, cunning squint; a 'LEGAL NOTICE' page floats up from her diary.

beats.line: Notice-votice chhodo. April-May aur September-October mein naukri chhodne ka risk mat lena.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji laughs softly; the 'LEGAL NOTICE' folds into a paper plane and turns into 'DATES'.
beats.card: Card: 'JOB: NO RISKS 5 Apr–6 May · 21 Sep–21 Oct'

beats.line: Paisa theek-thaak se behtar rahega, March-April aur June mein sabse badhiya.
beats.picture: Gold coins drift up from the scroll; Sakshi's eyes light up.

beats.line: Toh Ferrari?
beats.picture: Sakshi sneaks a red car doodle (generic, no logo) into her diary, side-eye.

beats.line: FD.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji, one-word deadpan; the car doodle turns into 'FD'. Sakshi pouts.

beats.line: June se November tak pyaar mein Guru ka saath hai.
beats.picture: Hearts float up from the scroll.
beats.card: Card: 'LOVE + SHAADI ✓ 26 Jun–26 Nov · Vedic maanyata'

beats.line: Waah!
beats.picture: Sakshi claps and blushes.

beats.line: Bas August-October mein behas mat karna.
beats.picture: A tiny storm cloud passes over a heart; then Vishnu ji leans in with a teasing smile, turning the tables.
beats.sound: Tiny thunder, then a sly pluck.

beats.line: Aur ghar mein badon ki baat dil pe mat lena.
beats.picture: Cut-in: a warm family home with diyas. Vishnu ji calm, palm on heart.
beats.card: Card: 'FAMILY: badon ka samman' + 'PROPERTY: sirf saaf deal'

beats.line: Mummy ki daant bhi?
beats.picture: Sakshi, hopeful loophole face.

beats.line: Wo daant nahi, prasad hai, sar aankhon pe.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji amused smile, gentle head tilt; Sakshi bows her head, giggling.

beats.line: Karna bas itna hai: Mangalwar ko Sundarkand padho, chaandi pehno, aur kisi netraheen ko pyaar se khana khilao.
beats.picture: One card; the three words of its second row appear on the spoken words. Sakshi writes each, nodding.
beats.card: Card: 'UPAY · Vedic maanyata' + 'Sundarkand · Chaandi · Bhojan seva'

beats.line: Aur is saal brake bhi lagana, aur gym bhi jaana.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji serene blessing with a playful smile; the ram doodle gently brakes at the STOP sign this time. The scroll closes with a glow.

beats.line: Aries walo, sun liya na? Apne Aries dost ko ye bhej do, mahine-wise poori guide link mein hai.
beats.picture: CTA. Sakshi alone (no deity): the one wink, points to the viewer, send arrow, link chip.
Sakshi's diary shows 'ARIES 2027 ✓' with a ram doodle; Sakshi alone with her diary (no deity in the selling part). Card: 'Send to your Aries friend · Guide: link'. Loops to frame 0.
